A Magna é líder inovadora no desenvolvimento e fabricação de sistemas de assentos de alta qualidade. Nossa solução inclui estruturas de assentos, mecanismos, hardware, além de espuma e produtos de acabamento para as indústrias automotiva, de caminhões pesados e ônibus. title: Desenvolvedor(a) de Software (Vaga Afirmativa Prioritária para Pessoas Negras), Intech
description:
Amazon.com's long-term vision is to enable a seamless global shopping experience for all Amazon customers worldwide on any Amazon website or device, in any language and for any culture. Our goal is to create software that offers customers a unique shopping experience that is internationalized for their preferences.

Our team is responsible for automating the launch strategy for Amazon's expansion into new countries. We build customer-facing features in a highly distributed environment that directly impacts Amazon’s e-commerce revenue in over 150+ countries.

About you:

You're looking for a career where you'll be able to build, to deliver, and to impress. You build customer facing features that reach millions of new customers all over the world. You look at problems holistically, and thrive on the intricate complexity of designing feedback loops and ecosystems. You want to work on projects where you are leveraging Machine Learning models to implement solutions to real problems that require creative and deep understanding of the problem space. You challenge yourself and others to constantly come up with better solutions. You work closely with the business to define the expansion strategy and figure out innovative solutions to help this thriving business continue its exponential growth.

About us together:

We're going to eliminate vendor complexity so they can make products available in any market place. Along the way, we're going to face seemingly impossible problems. We're going to argue about how to solve them, and we'll work together to find a solution that is superior to each of the proposals we came in with. We'll make tough decisions, but we'll all understand why. We'll be the dream team.

The ideal engineer for this space will be highly quantitative, have great judgment and passion for building a great customer experience, be inventive, and have a strong track record of delivery. You also have a pragmatic approach and iterative approach to building software: you have an ability to simplify and get things done with a demonstrated track record of building and delivering software and working effectively with external and internal teams.

Amazon Brazil values Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) in all our positions, and therefore, we intentionally work to ensure that our internal environment reflects the diversity of the markets we serve and the customers we serve. In Brazil, we have structured a Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee composed of representatives from different areas and positions, as we understand that this agenda requires different perspectives and multiple experiences. Our leadership is engaged and increasingly understands its role in spreading and practicing our leadership principles, with the aim of being "the best company to work for in the world." We know our responsibility and the need for change, and we are aware that "Success and growth bring great responsibilities."

Our affinity groups are formed by voluntary individuals from different business units and are an active part of defining DEI strategies. They act as ambassadors for this agenda and will support you from Day 1. Remember, "it's always Day 1." The groups are organized in the following fronts: BEN - Black Employee Network, , Glamazon (LGBTQIA+), and People with Disabilities.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  1. 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
  2. 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
  3. Experience programming with at least one software programming language

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  1. 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
  2. Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:
Programador em Inteligência Artificial (IA)

Sobre a Empresa

Somos uma empresa inovadora no setor de saúde, com foco em soluções tecnológicas que transformam a experiência do cuidado domiciliar. Buscamos um Programador em Inteligência Artificial para integrar nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de sistemas inteligentes que impactam positivamente a vida de pacientes, profissionais e parceiros.

Descrição do Cargo

O Programador em IA será responsável por criar, implementar e otimizar algoritmos e modelos de inteligência artificial, atuando desde o tratamento de grandes volumes de dados até a implantação de soluções em aplicações reais, como reconhecimento de voz, visão computacional e processamento de linguagem natural. Este profissional terá papel fundamental na inovação dos nossos serviços, garantindo eficiência, precisão e escalabilidade nas soluções desenvolvidas.

Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento de Algoritmos

Criar e implementar algoritmos de IA que permitam às máquinas aprender com dados e tomar decisões autônomas.
Adaptar e customizar algoritmos para diferentes aplicações e necessidades do negócio.


Modelagem e Tratamento de Dados

Coletar, tratar e preparar grandes volumes de dados para uso em modelos de IA.
Garantir a qualidade, integridade e segurança dos dados utilizados.


Implantação de Soluções de IA

Desenvolver e implantar sistemas de IA em aplicações como reconhecimento de voz, visão computacional, processamento de linguagem natural, entre outros.
Integrar soluções de IA aos sistemas existentes da empresa.


Aprendizado de Máquina

Aplicar técnicas de machine learning para criar modelos preditivos, de classificação e agrupamento.
Utilizar redes neurais e outras abordagens avançadas conforme a necessidade do projeto.


Testes e Otimização

Realizar testes rigorosos para validar o desempenho dos sistemas de IA.
Otimizar modelos e algoritmos para garantir eficiência, precisão e escalabilidade.


Documentação e Melhoria Contínua

Documentar processos, códigos e resultados dos projetos de IA.
Buscar constantemente novas técnicas, ferramentas e tendências para aprimorar as soluções desenvolvidas.

Principais Habilidades

Conhecimento em Programação: Domínio de linguagens como Python (essencial), R, Java, C++ ou C#.
Matemática e Estatística: Forte base em álgebra linear, cálculo e estatística para compreensão e implementação de algoritmos.
Aprendizado de Máquina: Familiaridade com conceitos de regressão, classificação, agrupamento, redes neurais e deep learning.
Resolução de Problemas: Capacidade de identificar e solucionar desafios complexos relacionados ao desenvolvimento e implementação de IA.
Conhecimento em Sistemas Operacionais: Experiência com Linux, Windows e macOS.
Trabalho em Equipe: Colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares, incluindo profissionais de tecnologia, saúde e negócios.
Comunicação: Clareza na comunicação de ideias técnicas para públicos diversos.

Aplicações Práticas do Cargo

Desenvolvimento de Chatbots e Assistentes Virtuais: Sistemas de interação natural com usuários, utilizando processamento de linguagem natural.
Visão Computacional: Soluções que permitem interpretação de imagens e vídeos por máquinas.
Reconhecimento de Voz: Sistemas capazes de entender e processar a fala humana.
Recomendações Personalizadas: Algoritmos que sugerem produtos, serviços ou conteúdos com base em preferências dos usuários.
Automação de Processos: Otimização de fluxos operacionais por meio de IA.

Requisitos

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência comprovada em projetos de IA e machine learning.
Conhecimento em frameworks e bibliotecas de IA (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Keras, etc.).
Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais.
Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação e artigos científicos.

Diferenciais

Pós-graduação ou cursos de especialização em IA, Data Science ou áreas afins.
Experiência no segmento de saúde.
Participação em comunidades, eventos ou publicações na área de IA.

Creative & Design is the full-service agency powered by ZS—the world’s largest professional services company focused on health. Valued team member working in the advertising, design, and communications space with an emphasis on global health clients and brands. The Visual Design Pleno (Studio) is a key member of our São Paulo-based design studio and part of a global team (teammates in New York, California, London, and India). The São Paulo design group will be focused on executing established designs across a broad range of tactics for US and global brands primarily in the health space. This group will be connected to and working with teams primarily based in the United States. As the Visual Design Pleno (Studio) in our São Paulo office, your role is multifaceted. You will support the Senior Visual Designer (Studio Lead) in driving the design output of the Sao Paolo group (graphic design, information, and content design); help create and maintain efficient and effective work practices; establish and uphold best practices for creating and maintaining design systems, and act as a collaborative partner to creative brand-leads and cross-functional team members.

  • Create within established brand guidelines and health industry regulations to update existing pieces and create new ones based on provided manuscripts.

  • Help lead the team to work within established brand guidelines and health industry regulations to update existing pieces and create new ones based on provided manuscripts.

  • Help ensure files are properly prepared for final release across a variety of mediums including print production, mechanical builds, file structure, and other related issues.
  • Own the final steps of print and digital layout design and delivery.
  • Provide image retouching, clipping paths, and additional image manipulation.
  • Maintain production files, including fonts, images, logos, and other artwork.
  • Update existing files and layouts to incorporate change.
  • Help set priorities and manage workloads so that assignments are completed within agreed-upon time frames.
  • Provide creative feedback and ongoing coaching to grow people’s creative and technical skills.
  • Share experience and knowledge of the industry.
  • Collaborate closely with art directors, designers, developers, copywriters, and other cross-functional team members.

What you will bring:

  • Must demonstrate strong art direction and graphic design skills across a variety of mediums.
  • Must be able to demonstrate effective oral and written English communication skills.
  • Strong typographic and layout skills.
  • Ability to design across a broad range of mediums including print, print sales collateral (brochures, flyers), OOH (poster, signage, etc.), PowerPoint, digital/interactive (website, social, banner ads), digital sales materials (interactive PDFs, Veeva), video graphic elements, and email.
  • Design and information into coherent, high-impact communications while adhering to established brand guidelines.
  • Skilled working in Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator), Veeva, PowerPoint.
  • Managerial and leadership skills.
  • Knowledge of the latest Web and graphic design trends and tools.
  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work well within a team setting.
  • Interest in incorporating AI tools into work.
  • Advertising and marketing school or coursework.
  • Art school or coursework.
  • Related areas of study.
  • 5+ years of graphic design, studio, or related work experience.

ZS offers a comprehensive total rewards package including health and well-being, financial planning, annual leave, personal growth, and professional development. Our robust skills development programs, multiple career progression options, and internal mobility paths and collaborative culture empower you to thrive as an individual and global team member.

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.

Travel is a requirement at ZS for client-facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Location: Brazil

Salary: Competitive

About the Company

Our client is a global leader in the manufacture and supply of renewable energy components, including solar modules, inverters, mounting brackets , and related systems. With a strong foundation in China and expanding operations across Latin America, the company supports utility-scale and distributed generation projects with high-quality, cost-effective solutions.

To strengthen its commercial presence in the region, the company is seeking a Sales Manager based in Brazil to lead sales efforts and client engagement across the country and wider LATAM markets.

Role Overview

As Sales Manager, you will be responsible for driving regional sales growth by promoting a portfolio of solar PV components—particularly modules, inverters, and structural mounting brackets —to EPCs, developers, and distributors. The ideal candidate will have experience in technical sales and cross-border business development, with a strong understanding of Brazil's renewable energy landscape.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute sales strategies focused on solar PV components for the Brazilian market

  • Manage relationships with key clients, including EPC contractors, developers, and energy distributors

  • Promote the company’s product range: solar modules, string and central inverters, and mounting/bracket systems

  • Participate in bid responses, RFPs, and tender processes, working closely with technical and pricing teams

  • Monitor local regulatory developments, market dynamics, and competitor activity

  • Represent the company at industry events, trade shows, and conferences across Brazil and LATAM

  • Provide input into pricing strategies and inventory planning for the region

  • Prepare regular reporting on sales performance, forecasts, and client feedback

  • Achieve or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets

Candidate Requirements

  • 3–5 years of sales or business development experience in renewable energy, industrial equipment, or electrical components

  • Knowledge of solar modules, inverters, and mounting/bracket systems is highly desirable

  • Experience working in or selling to the Brazilian energy market

  • Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and client management skills

  • Strong understanding of B2B sales cycles and project timelines in the energy sector

  • Portuguese and English fluency required; Mandarin is an advantage

  • Based in Brazil or willing to relocate

Why Apply?

This is a key opportunity to help shape the presence of a globally respected OEM in one of the most active solar markets in the world. With Brazil’s continued investment in renewables, you will play a central role in delivering the components that power the region’s clean energy future.

  4. Coordenar processos que garantam uma assistência segura e de qualidade a todos os pacientes sob sua responsabilidade nas diferentes situações críticas, através das diretrizes institucionais, a fim de garantir uma assistência segura.
  5. Promover e participar da integração da equipe multiprofissional, dos treinamentos e eventos pertinentes, procurando garantir uma assistência integral ao cliente e familiares.
  6. Apoiar demais setores, conforme direcionamento de liderança, viabilizando o atendimento de todos os pacientes no HSC.
  7. Garantir a comunicação ativa junto a equipe multidisciplinar visando facilitar o planejamento e execução das ações pertinentes as boas práticas e contribuir com o desenvolvimento do colaborador realizando acompanhamento e treinamento dos colaboradores recém-admitidos, com exercício de mesma função assistencial.
  8. Garantir as ações de preventiva e corretiva dos equipamentos da unidade, preservando o funcionamento adequado conforme políticas institucionais.
  9. Realizar notificações de não conformidades e eventos identificados visando manter a qualidade e segurança da assistência prestada.
  10. Executar as práticas de segurança através do cumprimento das normativas da NR-32, medicina ocupacional, SCIH e SEST.
  11. Contribuir para a elaboração e implementação de manuais técnicos operacionais para a equipe de enfermagem nos diversos setores de atuação e na elaboração e implementação de manuais educativos aos clientes e familiares.
  12. Encaminhar os pacientes para o centro cirúrgico, checando o pré-operatório de acordo com o diagnóstico do paciente por meio de ferramenta sistematizada (SAEP- Sistematização de Assistência de Enfermagem Peri operatória) para garantir a segurança de acordo com as metas internacionais.
  13. Promover e difundir medidas de prevenção de riscos e agravos por meio da educação paciente e familiares, objetivando melhorar a qualidade de vida do paciente.

INSTITUIÇÃO

Há 120 anos no Brasil, a Associação Congregação de Santa Catarina (ACSC) é responsável pela administração de 19 entidades com atuação social, em saúde e educação, que formam a Rede Santa Catarina. Com um modelo de gestão em que o superávit gerado é aplicado em nossas obras a fim de executar dignamente nossas atividades, a instituição acolhe e cuida do ser humano em todo o ciclo da vida.

MISSÃO: Acolher e cuidar do ser humano durante todo o ciclo da vida.

VISÃO: Ser referência de entidade filantrópica reconhecida pela sociedade, demonstrando amor às pessoas por meio de nossos atos.

VALORES: Preservação da vida, Humanização, Dignidade, Transparência e Sustentabilidade.

title: Early Findings: CBD Promotes Tooth Biomineralization
description:
Early Findings: CBD Promotes Tooth Biomineralization

A new study suggests that cannabidiol (CBD) can trigger biomineralization of teeth under inflammatory conditions, thus promoting tissue repair. The research, published in the Journal of Dentistry , may have implications for future dental therapies.

Previous studies have found that CBD exhibits anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties when put in contact with dental pulp stem cells. In vitro research also suggests that the compound may have osteogenic and odontogenic effects. With this in mind, the researchers behind the current study investigated the effects of CBD on dental pulp cells under pro-inflammatory stimuli.

To do so, they exposed cells from the dental pulp of mice to a cytokine called tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-α), implicated in both inflammatory and autoimmune processes. They then treated the cells with varying CBD concentrations for periods spanning 24 hours to seven days.

“The ability of the cells to survive and function in this environment was evaluated, which allowed us to determine if the substance has any bioactive effect on them,” said study author Francisco Wanderley Garcia de Paula-Silva, professor in the Department of Pediatrics at the University of São Paulo, Brazil, in a press release.

The researchers also studied the formation of mineralization nodules and assessed the effect of CBD in modulating the synthesis of inflammatory mediators by macrophages.

Ultimately, they found that CBD stimulated the capacity for tooth biomineralization and inhibited the synthesis of inflammatory mediators, pointing towards an anti-inflammatory effect.

“These findings indicate that cannabidiol may be a promising bioactive substance for tissue repair in inflammatory contexts, which opens up new perspectives for its use in dental treatments, especially in regenerative dentistry, benefiting patients in different clinical situations,” said Paula-Silva.

“The growing interest in cannabinoid-based therapies, coupled with a deeper understanding of cannabidiol’s mechanisms of action, may facilitate future clinical trials, especially as more data become available,” he added.

Sources: EurekAlert, Journal of Dentistry

description:

ATRIBUIÇÕES PRINCIPAIS

  1. Executar os procedimentos privativos e relacionados a práticas avançadas de enfermagem, através das diretrizes do modelo assistencial para garantir as melhores práticas como realizar e orientar diluições e rediluições de medicamentos conforme faixa etária/ peso/ restrição hídrica.
  2. Receber o plantão e proceder a assistência direta aos pacientes, observando, acompanhando, reconhecendo sinais/sintomas e registrando as ações e, ao término do plantão informar e esclarecer a assistência prestada aos pacientes através da passagem de plantão em instrumento estruturado institucional.
  3. Realizar e planejar a Sistematização da Assistência de Enfermagem (SAE) estabelecendo níveis de responsabilidade na execução das ações planejadas entre equipe de enfermagem, avaliando os resultados e registrando-os durante a internação, através das necessidades de cada paciente.
  4. Coordenar processos que garantam uma assistência segura e de qualidade a todos os pacientes sob sua responsabilidade nas diferentes situações críticas, através das diretrizes institucionais, a fim de garantir uma assistência segura, reconhecendo e priorizando de acordo com a complexidade assistencial as situações de emergência e a necessidade de cada paciente direcionando a assistência a ser prestada.
  5. Aprazar e conferir os itens de prescrição médica para continuidade da assistência segura.
  6. Apoiar demais setores, conforme direcionamento de liderança, viabilizando o atendimento de todos os pacientes internados no HSC, garantir as ações de preventiva e corretiva dos equipamentos da unidade, preservando o funcionamento adequado conforme políticas institucionais.
  7. Participar dos treinamentos e eventos institucionais pertinentes ao cargo, e capacitações profissionais para o desenvolvimento de sua carreira na Rede Santa Catarina.
  8. Contribuir para a elaboração e implementação de manuais técnicos operacionais para a equipe de enfermagem nos diversos setores de atuação também como manuais educativos aos clientes e familiares.
  9. Promover e participar da integração da equipe multiprofissional, procurando garantir uma assistência integral ao cliente e familiares.
  10. Participar ativamente de visita multidisciplinar buscando o alinhamento das necessidades assistenciais dos pacientes e familiares sob sua responsabilidade.
  11. Garantir a comunicação ativa junto a equipe multidisciplinar visando facilitar o planejamento e execução das ações pertinentes as boas práticas.
  12. Contribuir com o desenvolvimento do colaborador, através de educação em atividades baseadas em normas, protocolos e procedimentos institucionais, visando a atualização e aperfeiçoamento da equipe de enfermagem.
  13. Multiplicar informações relacionadas a boas práticas assistenciais, treinar e educar junto a equipe multidisciplinar e Educação continuada de área de atuação, cumprindo e fazendo cumprir as normas, regulamentos e legislações pertinentes às áreas de atuação, para colaboradores e acompanhamento de recém-admitidos.
  14. Realizar notificações de não conformidades e eventos identificados visando manter a qualidade e segurança da assistência prestada.
  15. Executar as práticas de segurança através do cumprimento das normativas da NR-32, medicina ocupacional, SCIH e SEST.
  16. Encaminhar os pacientes para o centro cirúrgico, checando o pré-operatório de acordo com o diagnóstico do paciente por meio de ferramenta sistematizada (SAEP- Sistematização de Assistência de Enfermagem Perioperatória) para garantir a segurança de acordo com as metas internacionais.
  17. Instalar e controlar a Terapia de Substituição Renal de fluxo lento: “Prisma” e Hemodiálise convencional através do monitoramento e cumprimento de protocolos de vigilância para prevenir eventos adversos.
  18. Realizar procedimento de punção de artéria radial, instalar monitorização hemodinâmica (PAI, IV1000) e prestar assistência direta e orientar os profissionais da equipe de enfermagem, conforme protocolo institucional.

INSTITUIÇÃO

Há 120 anos no Brasil, a Associação Congregação de Santa Catarina (ACSC) é responsável pela administração de 19 entidades com atuação social, em saúde e educação, que formam a Rede Santa Catarina. Com um modelo de gestão em que o superávit gerado é aplicado em nossas obras a fim de executar dignamente nossas atividades, a instituição acolhe e cuida do ser humano em todo o ciclo da vida. Ao todo são cerca de 10,5 mil colaboradores distribuídos em diversas instituições de saúde, mantendo inúmeros estabelecimentos de ensino e acolhendo crianças, adultos e idosos em espaços assistenciais, com atendimento humanizado e serviços de qualidade para milhares de pessoas em seis Estados brasileiros (Espírito Santo, Goiás, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina e São Paulo).

MISSÃO

Acolher e cuidar do ser humano durante todo o ciclo da vida.

VISÃO

Ser referência de entidade filantrópica reconhecida pela sociedade, demonstrando amor às pessoas por meio de nossos atos.

VALORES

Preservação da vida, Humanização, Dignidade, Transparência e Sustentabilidade.

title: Vendor Manager
description:
Amazon Brazil is looking for a dynamic vendor manager to play an important role within the International Imports team by adding selection, analyzing business data, driving vendor onboarding, negotiating terms and handling promotions. You will work with Brazilian and global vendors to drive all aspects of terms improvements, which includes analysis and projections, as well as direct negotiations with decision makers. Additionally, you will increase product category sales by driving store marketing promotions, negotiating partners to improve selection, and reacting to industry-related economic trends.
You will have excellent verbal and written communication, the ability to analyze and communicate complex terms and margin structures, and work well across other teams including Retail, Finance, and Inventory Management. Candidates who are organized, flexible, creative, analytical, and able to drive negotiations through completion will be highly appreciated. Strong ownership values, a real passion for innovation, and hustle are also key to succeed in this position.
If you are passionate about e-commerce and career growth, this opportunity with Amazon.com.br is for you!

Key job responsibilities

Retail Managers focus on and act at the intersection of customers, vendors, and functional teams:

CUSTOMERS: They rely on specialized teams for customer and category information and insights, and work with and influence other teams to get the category-specific customer needs addressed. The Retail Manager is responsible for holding category-specific knowledge about customers and their needs, emerging product trends, market segment evolution, and new business opportunities.
VENDORS: RM are the ultimate owners of the vendor relationship, with a direct focus on the top vendors that drive the vast majority of sales. They are directly responsible for auditing and escalating performance, improving overall terms and cost structures of the relationship by means of negotiation, and for developing long-term partnerships with new and existing vendors to drive topline and selection fueling category growth.
CENTRAL AND FUNCTIONAL TEAMS: As a business owner, the RM represents customer and business needs in interaction with central teams, projects, and initiatives. The Retail Manager drives central teams for the evolution of customer-facing and internal systems to improve the customer experience from the category perspective. At the same time, they implement centrally driven initiatives within the category to drive CX or cost improvements, prioritizing based on impact and potential tradeoffs, and if need be pushing back on selected initiatives.

A day in the life: Vendor Managers manage inputs by driving selection, securing great prices, and increasing convenience/speed to accelerate Amazon’s flywheel.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Team management experience;
- Account management, project or program management, or buying experience;
- Experience with vendor negotiations, pricing and promotion or inventory management;
- Master's degree;
- Knowledge of Microsoft Access or SQL;
- Experience using data to influence business decisions;
- Experience driving internal cross-team collaboration;
- Experience with business analysis and P&L management.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience managing large data sets and utilizing them to drive performance and process improvements;
- Experience in vendor negotiations, pricing and promotion, inventory management, and product development.

  • Tracks performance of routine and preventative maintenance to ensure availability of HVAC systems and troubleshoot HVAC/R systems with complex problems and extensive repairs requiring judgement to locate malfunctions.

  • Able to maneuver in small spaces and lift up to 50lbs.

  • Bachelor’s degree and three years of experience College, Vocational School, or High School diploma or equivalent and a combination of 10 years’ education and experience with a valid Master HVAC license, or equivalent, at a State level; or 12 years’ experience in an equivalent Military HVAC training/certification.

  • Ability to plan, install, troubleshoot and repair equipment and systems not fully covered by technical manuals, schematics, etc.

Join to apply for the MÉDICO ORTOPEDISTA - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realizar atendimento clínico e cirúrgico em Ortopedia nas áreas: CER, enfermarias, centro cirúrgico, unidade de terapia intensiva e ambulatório do Hospital.

Acerca del área de Estrategia y Transacciones

Como profesional de Estrategia y Transacciones en EY tendrás la posibilidad de asesorar a inversores estratégicos y financieros a lo largo del proceso de Due Diligence financiero y contable en fusiones, adquisiciones, escisiones y reorganizaciones de empresas, y dando soporte en la identificación de indicadores claves del valor de las empresas target y contribuyendo a mitigar los riesgos inherentes en una transacción de M&A tanto en procesos de “buy side” como de “sell side”.

Podrás sumarte a un equipo dinámico dedicado exclusivamente a transacciones que participa no solo en proyectos locales, regionales y globales para Argentina y Sudamérica, sino también de manera muy activa en procesos de M&A en Estados Unidos, brindando una experiencia internacional muy relevante.

description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Sobre a Vaga:

Na Laços Saúde, acreditamos que o cuidado deve ser um reflexo da individualidade de cada pessoa, promovendo a autonomia e a qualidade de vida dos nossos pacientes. Como parte do nosso compromisso com um modelo inovador de assistência, buscamos Médicos Geriatras apaixonados pela transformação do cuidado à saúde no ambiente domiciliar, seguindo os princípios do modelo Buurtzorg, que prioriza o autocuidado e a manutenção das funcionalidades das pessoas em suas próprias comunidades.

Diagnóstico que Buscamos:

  • Formação em Medicina com Residência em Geriatria, Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM).
  • Experiência prévia em atenção domiciliar ou saúde comunitária será um diferencial.
  • Paixão por promover o autocuidado e a autonomia dos pacientes, com uma abordagem centrada na pessoa.
  • Habilidade em comunicação e empatia, fundamentais para o estabelecimento de vínculos com pacientes e familiares.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa e multidisciplinar, integrando ações que promovam a saúde do paciente no seu ambiente familiar.
  • Proatividade na busca de soluções que promovam a qualidade de vida e a funcionalidade dos pacientes.

Sobre Nós:

Na Laços Saúde, a diversidade é o coração do nosso trabalho. Acreditamos que cuidar é um ato de amor e acolhimento, e isso se reflete em nossa equipe, que é composta por profissionais de diversas origens e experiências. O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e as necessidades de cada pessoa. Se você é um fisioterapeuta que acredita na transformação do cuidado à saúde, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e ajude a moldar o futuro da saúde no Brasil. Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas.

Tem Paixão pelo Cuidado? Então junte-se a nós!

A Laços Saúde está pronta para receber você!

Vamos juntos cuidar da saúde da comunidade!

Proporcionar atendimento de qualidade, acessível e humanizado através da telemedicina, promovendo o bem-estar mental e emocional dos pacientes. O médico geriatra deve atuar com empatia, responsabilidade e ética, garantindo diagnósticos e tratamentos assertivos, respeitando a individualidade de cada paciente e contribuindo para a melhoria de sua qualidade de vida. Fortalecer a confiança no atendimento remoto, assegurando que cada consulta seja conduzida com o mesmo rigor e acolhimento de um atendimento presencial.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Atuar em consonância com os valores da organização, mantendo conduta focada em resultados do Cuidado, respeitando a individualidade de cada paciente, tornando a assistência personalizada.
  • Registrar no Prontuário do Paciente as informações inerentes e indispensáveis ao processo de cuidar, mantendo-os atualizados.
  • Ser representante da organização, zelando por suas premissas, prestando cuidado baseado em evidências científicas e melhores práticas.

description:
Kaizen Gaming, the team powering Betano, is one of the biggest GameTech companies in the world, operating in 19 markets.We always aim to leverage cutting-edge technology, providing the best experience to our millions of customers who trust us for their entertainment.

We are a diverse team of more than 2.700 Kaizeners, from 40+ nationalities spreading across 3 continents. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation,or age.

Our #oneteam is proud to be among the Best Workplaces in Europe and certified Great Place to Work across our offices. Here, there’ll be no average day for you. Ready to Press Play on Potential?

Let’s start with the role

We are looking for an experienced and highly skilled Principal Database Administrator to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and optimizing our MS SQL Server environments, with a strong focus on availability, security, and performance. You will play a key role in ensuring the continuous operation of our databases, particularly in complex, high-availability scenarios such as Availability Groups. In addition, you will bring your knowledge of alternative database engines like MongoDB and CockroachDB, as well as your expertise in cloud-based database administration.

As a Principal Database Administrator, you will:

  • Provide comprehensive day-to-day support, monitoring, troubleshooting, and administration for multiple MS SQL databases, with a particular focus on high-availability configurations like Availability Groups.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex performance and availability issues, with in-depth root cause analysis to prevent future occurrences.
  • Oversee database maintenance processes, including performance tuning , index management, and job automation, ensuring optimal operation.
  • Develop and enforce policies for backup and recovery , ensuring database resilience and disaster recovery readiness.
  • Apply security patches , conduct version upgrades, and enforce strict compliance with database security best practices.
  • Handle support calls and resolve technical issues swiftly, including response to security incidents and operational challenges.
  • Leverage expertise in alternative database engines like MongoDB and CockroachDB to contribute to cross-functional database projects.
  • Manage and optimize cloud-based database environments , ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability in cloud infrastructure.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Solidhands-on experience in MS SQL Server Database Administration in production environments.
  • Extensive experience with MS SQL Server database features, including Jobs Scheduling, Monitoring, Patching, Backup/Recovery, Replication, Availability Groups , and Always On configurations.
  • Proven expertise in diagnosing and resolving performance bottlenecks and availability issues .
  • Solid understanding of alternative database engines like PostgreSQL , MongoDB and CockroachDB , with practical experience in their administration and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in cloud database administration , with experience in cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Fluency in English , both written and verbal, with excellent communication skills.
  • Strong teamwork, analytical thinking, and problem-solving abilities, alongside a proactive approach to continuous learning.
  • A commitment to mentoring and supporting junior team members.

The Psychologist provides counseling and psychological assessment and testing within an outpatient program. Performs assessment, testing for individual, family and group counseling. Coordinates and implements the treatment plan. Provides crisis intervention as necessary. Services are provided to adults, adolescents, children, families, and couples using knowledge and skills necessary to provide care appropriate to the age of the patients. In concert with psychiatrists, maintains a team approach in treating patients. Adheres to professional and ethical guidelines as outlined by mental health care organizations and associations.

Gratifying to work with different patient populations.
Opportunity for further didactics and other educational opportunities.
Opportunity to be part of a growing department/service line.
Harmonious, team-oriented working environment.

WORKING SCHEDULE:

Typical working schedule Monday-Friday 7:30a – 4p.
No call, weekends or holidays.
Opportunity to work virtually one day per week.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Demonstrates competency in the assessment, range of treatment, knowledge of growth and development and communication appropriate to the age of the patient treated.
  2. Conducting scientific studies of behavior patterns and cognitive function.
  3. Observing and interviewing individuals, recording the interactions.
  4. Researching psychological, emotional, behavioral or organizational patterns and identifying issues.
  5. Diagnosing potential disorders.
  6. Discussing possible methods of treatment with patients.
  7. Researching and writing papers on clinical psychology issues and disorders.
  8. Performs appropriate treatment services to assigned clients. Uses interventions with assigned clients which meet accepted standards of mental health care and reflect consideration of treatment plan. Provides crisis management for assigned cases and is able to provide back up for the program.
  9. Maintains amount of weekly scheduled client hours as required by departmental needs and standards.
  10. Participates as a treatment team member and maintains a current level of psychological theory and practice. Attends clinical supervision meetings and staff meetings as scheduled and comes to meetings prepared. Keeps current with professional literature and trends in mental health. Attends continuing education trainings, workshops, seminars or conferences in order to keep current with evidenced based standards of practice and maintain licensure.
  11. Maintains active communication with identified staff and agencies that share case involvement when appropriate releases are signed.
  12. Maintains appropriate records of service rendered to or on behalf of the client populations served. Maintains clinical records of all client contacts according to QA & I, State and Joint Commission guidelines. Produces an evaluation report which effectively addresses the reason for referral and reflects the sound organization and synthesis of fact, impressions and clinical recommendations. Completes progress notes, reports and correspondence in a timely manner.
  13. Exercises appropriate self-management in the performance of all duties.
  14. Completes client satisfaction tools as required by departmental standards.
  15. Performs thorough Risk Assessment at intake session and as needed thereafter.
  16. Supports community and/or network departments and service lines by speaking at support groups, teaching about mental wellness related topics, providing stress management seminars and like duties as assigned.
  17. Provides Psychological services (psychotherapy via video, tele-therapy through hospital vetted format) as assigned.

EDUCATION/TRAINING REQUIREMENTS:

Must have a Clinical PsyD or PHD in clinical Psychology or related area.
Prefer graduate from a Neuropsychological curriculum.
Prefer rehab psychology or Neuropsychology internship and 2 year post doc.
Clinical training shall include diagnostic skills and clinical interventions which meet accepted and current standards of care.
Must be knowledgeable in Neuropsychological Assessment and Psychological related to Psychiatric Diagnosis assessments.
Outpatient evaluations, Neuropsychological Testing, Report Writing & Interpretation, Feedback, Therapy.
Must be able to perform pre-surgical epilepsy evaluations and potentially Wada’s.

Sit up to 8 hours per day; 3 hours at a time. Stand for up to 8 hours per day; 8 hours at a time. Walking for up to 6 hours per day. Frequently lifting, carrying and pushing objects up to 10 pounds. Rarely lifting, carrying and pushing objects up to 75 pounds. Frequently stooping and bending. Frequently reaching above shoulder level. Frequently handling, firm grasping and twisting & turning as it relates to performing procedures. Must be able to perceive attributes of an object through touch. Must be able to hear as it relates to normal conversation, high and low frequencies. Must be able to see as it relates to general, near, far, color and peripheral vision.   • Assist the Driller in operating drilling and mud circulating equipment as instructed in the well program and in accordance to Company policies and procedures.

Descrição do Cargo

Reporting

Reports to: Driller

Supervision

Derrickhand, Pumphand, and Floorhand, Rover

Pre-requisite/Qualification

  • High School Diploma (U.S.)/ Proof of Completion of Formal Education or Relevant Craft Certificate (where applicable)
  • Successful Military Discharge – Preferred for U.S.
  • Graduate of Trade School or University where knowledge and training acquired are applicable to job requirements – Preferred
  • Valid medical examination and vaccination certificates
  • Knowledge of all technical calculations required for the safe operation within the drilling operations.
  • Basic computer skills
  • Valid well control certificate per the standard defined on the training matrix.

General Requirements

  • Promotes a Safe and Respectful Work Environment: Proactively promotes and Maintains a healthy respect for open and transparent dialogue between all levels of personnel.
  • Demonstrates care for the safety and well-being of all personnel, at all times. Invests in each person to provide equal opportunity for development and advancement of those qualified, to fulfill their career objectives. Respects the dignity of all personnel and recognizes their merit.
  • Attend and participate in all required Safety and Operational meetings.
  • Participate fully in the annual performance appraisal process, competency assessments based on performance against Operational Discipline requirements.
  • Complete company training requirements for the Assistant Driller job level as per the training matrix, including in local/regulatory requirements.
  • If applicable, the duties and responsibilities in the safety case for this position must be observed.
  • Full participation in emergency drills and respond to emergency situations as per assigned duties on the station bill.
  • Norway Specific: Responsible to follow up on the working environment within the rig department.

Operational Discipline Requirements

  • Disciplined application and participation in the Task Planning & Risk Assessment Process.
  • This is inclusive of:
  • Understanding and perform the roles and responsibilities as assigned at the pre-job meeting.
  • Understanding the hazards associated with the task.
  • Understanding and effectively implementing the control measures required to mitigate identified hazards.
  • Execute all tasks and task steps in a disciplined manner, following the sequence detailed in the relevant procedures.
  • Recognize at risk behavior or conditions during tasks and call ‘Time out for Safety’ when unsure, or when the job does not go as planned.
  • Participate in After Action Reviews to feedback lessons learned from performing the task.

Hse Requirements

  • Demonstrate commitment and leadership in the protection of personnel, the environment, and assets.
  • Coach personnel in the understanding of applicable Company OI & HSE requirements.
  • Ensure work is executed in accordance with Company OI & HSE requirements.
  • Call a Time Out when a real or perceived at risk behavior or unsafe condition is observed.
  • Coach personnel to use WorkSight ENGAGE during the execution of planned work.
  • Use WorkSight COACH during the execution of planned work and daily operations to reinforce Company requirements.
  • Report all incidents, potential hazards, or abnormal situations. Ensure reported situations are acknowledged properly.
  • Ensure the Control of Work process is complied with when planning and managing the execution of work.
  • Ensure major accident barriers / controls are maintained.
  • Ensure safe and organized work areas are maintained.
  • Understand your role in an emergency, as designated in the Emergency Response Plan and Station Bill.
  • Lead or participate in all emergency drills and exercises, as required.
  • Ensure change is properly controlled and managed.

Duties

The underlying expectation is that all duties are carried out in compliance with the Company Operational Discipline expectations and HSE requirements. When considering assignment of duties for the Assistant Driller, the Supervisor and the Assistant Driller will apply the rules of task planning (CAKES) to determine if the assigned role is appropriate. This means confirming that the individuals involved have the knowledge, skills, and experience to carry out the task, and the task plan complies with policy before they are authorized to proceed.

Operations/Maintenance

GENERAL DUTIES:

  • Perform the drilling department’s daily checklists, i.e., QHSE checks, Derrick inspection, choke and mud manifold line ups, etc.
  • Maintain accurate BHA record of tubular and tool dimensions (i.e., internal and external diameter, fish neck, handling profiles and serial numbers etc.).
  • Calculate ton-miles on drilling line; maintain an accurate logbook and advise the Driller on the need to slip and cut.
  • Maintain an organized drilling equipment store and tubular and subs inventory.
  • Maintain proper communication with the Driller, Toolpusher, and other department heads.
  • Read and interpret various gauges and meters relating to the drilling operations; assist the Driller in maintaining records and logs.
  • Actively participate in pre-tour meeting with the drilling crew for all drilling operations.
  • Assist and relieve the Driller at the Driller’s console during drilling operations.
  • Assist with the preparation of equipment for impending drilling operations.
  • Organize and supervise the drilling crews for all operations.
  • Assist the Driller during an emergency or well control situation; assist in the well killing operations.
  • Assist in supervision of Preventive Maintenance carried out on drilling equipment.
  • Assist in supervision of repairs on drilling and associated equipment.
  • Assist in running and cementing casing strings, running and retrieving BOPs and risers, and other operations as directed by the Driller or Toolpusher.
  • Monitor mud systems and supervise solids control equipment and mud mixing operation.
  • Assist in the planning, organization and execution of rig move operations.
  • Operate drilling and associated equipment as directed by the Driller, i.e., Top Drive System, mud pumps, BOP and Diverter controls, etc.
  • Know the clients’ rules and Company procedures for well control and blowout prevention.
  • Incorporate the THINK process into all tasks, whether working alone or as part of a team.
  • Participate daily in START process.
  • Ensure subordinate personnel are properly trained in the START process.
  • Call a Time Out for Safety (TOFS) whenever an unplanned hazard or a change in the expected results is observed.
  • Ensure all relevant safety procedures and practices are adhered to during drilling operations, in accordance to the Company QHSE manual.
  • Report any incidents, potential hazards or abnormal situations to the Driller or Toolpusher.
  • Actively participate in weekly safety meetings and pre-tour meetings as required, FOCUS Improvement Process, and all other Company safety management systems.
  • Assist in conducting drilling operations safety drills as and when required.
  • Demonstrate commitment to the Company’s safety policies through leadership and guidance.
  • Ensure that a high standard of hygiene and housekeeping is maintained onboard the rig.
  • Meet the training requirements according to the applicable training matrix.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: preferencialmente presencial para frentes de negócio, predominantemente remoto para times de tecnologia e híbrido para as demais equipes. title: Banco de Talentos Para Pessoas com Deficiência
description:
Shape Your World

At Alcoa, you will become an essential part of our purpose: to turn raw potential into real progress. Every Alcoan is a work-shaper, team-shaper, idea-shaper, and world-shaper.

Reforçando nosso compromisso de construir ambientes cada vez mais diversos, plurais e equitativos, abrimos nosso banco de talentos para Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD), para trabalhar no Consórcio de Alumínio do Maranhão – Alumar, em São Luís (MA).

Alinhados às diretrizes globais de Inclusão & Diversidade, estamos comprometidos em gerar valor em todas as relações que mantemos com as partes interessadas de nosso negócio, comunidades e meio ambiente. Esse compromisso nos garante o selo de uma das Melhores Empresas para Trabalhar, pelo Great Place to Work, e também reconhecimento pelo Guia Exame de Diversidade e Instituto Ethos como uma das empresas com as melhores práticas do setor em prol da inclusão e equidade de gênero, étnico e racial, de Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD), e de pessoas LGBTQIA+.

Se você se identifica e quer contar essa história com a gente, te convidamos a fazer parte do nosso Banco de Talentos para Pessoas com Deficiência.

Quem pode se inscrever?

Profissionais que possuem alguma deficiência podem cadastrar o seu currículo no nosso sistema. E quando houver uma oportunidade alinhada ao seu perfil, entraremos em contato para dar continuidade ao processo seletivo!

O que esperamos de você?

Valorizamos suas habilidades e competências, e os conhecimentos adquiridos até aqui.

Sua identificação com os nossos valores é essencial, além da vontade de querer aprender, ética, flexibilidade em cenários desafiadores, relacionamento colaborativo e comprometimento com suas atividades.

Ao nosso lado, você terá diferentes oportunidades de crescimento e poderá realmente fazer a diferença, pertencendo a uma organização que respeita e considera a diversidade como parte de um dos pilares estratégicos.

Por que a Alcoa?

Nossos valores - Agir com integridade, Operar com excelência, Cuidar das pessoas e Liderar com coragem - estão na base de tudo o que fazemos.

Por aqui, estamos comprometidos em criar um local de trabalho inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam trazer tudo de si para o trabalho. Sabemos que tudo começa e termina com você, e é por isso que nosso valor "Cuidar das pessoas" é tão importante para nós. Ele garante não apenas sua segurança física, mas também fornece um ambiente inclusivo e acolhedor para todas as pessoas, incentivando a diversidade de pensamento de cada um e cada uma.

Abraçamos mudanças, novas ideias e promovemos uma cultura de respeito e oportunidades igualitárias. Nossos programas de desenvolvimento, sustentados pela diversidade, equidade e inclusão, são reconhecidos e ajudam a transformar a carreira das nossas pessoas. Ao nosso lado, você terá diferentes oportunidades de crescimento e poderá realmente fazer a diferença, sendo parte de uma organização que respeita e considera a flexibilidade, ao mesmo tempo que desafia as pessoas em um ambiente estimulante e inovador.

O que oferecemos?

  • Remuneração e benefícios competitivos e atrativos;
  • Academia Alcoa: trilhas de conhecimento e experiências de aprendizagem consistentes, diferenciadas e inclusivas, com conteúdos híbridos e completos para o seu desenvolvimento profissional;
  • Empresa baseada em valores, sendo que “Cuidar das Pessoas” está no centro de tudo o que fazemos;
  • Construir uma carreira de longo prazo;
  • Grupos de inclusão, incluindo AWN (Rede de Mulheres Alcoa), EAGLE (Funcionários da Alcoa pela Igualdade LGBTQIA+), AWARE (Alcoanos e Alcoanas Trabalhando Ativamente para a Equidade Étnico-racial) e ABLE (Alcoanos e Alcoanas Indo Além de Expectativas Limitantes);
  • Promoção da sustentabilidade e excelência operacional;
  • Uma cultura diversa, segura, inclusiva e equitativa;
  • Segurança é nossa maior prioridade - nossos dias começam e terminam com ela.

About the Location

The Alumar Consortium, managed by Alcoa, located 25 kilometers from the center of São Luís - MA, began its operations in 1984. It is made up of companies with a tradition in the areas of alumina and aluminum production, with different participations in the two factories that make up the Complex.

At Alcoa, we are committed to generating value in our relationships with all stakeholders in our business, communities, and environment. We build inclusive and secure environments so that our people can live and express themselves as they please. With the aim of attracting and retaining diverse talent, the company maintains inclusion groups that promote internal and external activities to value human diversity and plurality as a way of enriching one's own values.

We are values-led, vision-driven, and united by our purpose of transforming raw potential into real progress. Our commitments to Inclusion, Diversity & Equity include providing trusting workplaces that are safe, respectful, and inclusive of all individuals, free from discrimination, bullying, and harassment, and that our workplaces reflect the diversity of the communities in which we operate.

This is a place where you are empowered to do your best work, be your authentic self, and feel a true sense of belonging. Come join us and shape your career!

Your work. Your world. Shape them for the better.

title: Operador de Suporte Técnico
description:
DESCRIÇÃO SUMÁRIA:

Colaborador fica responsável por realizar atendimento ao cliente, suporte especializado, ativações, conferência de caixa, abrir Ordens de Serviço e realizar agendamentos, configuração de rede, suporte à internet via rádio, configuração e solicitação de portabilidade, criação de novas linhas e realizar plantões de atendimento.

DESCRIÇÃO DETALHADA:

  • Atendimento ao cliente: utilizando as plataformas whatsapp e take bip, telefone, e-mail, SAC do site da empresa, realiza o contato com o cliente. Recebe também a demanda de atendimento dos demais setores (comercial e financeiro) quando o cliente não consegue contato direto com o suporte. Durante o atendimento, realiza a tratativa de acordo com a necessidade do cliente, identifica a origem do problema;
  • Suporte especializado: ocorre em 02 situações, sendo elas identificadas como link loss e luz do power (DYING GASP). As duas serão necessárias abrir O.S. para realizar a troca do modem;
  • Ativações: a partir da contratação realizada pelo cliente, o suporte colhe as informações do mesmo através do sistema (resgatando o atendimento) faz alteração das configurações necessárias, e permanece com o atendimento. Em seguida, utiliza-se o número de identificação FHTT e autoriza-se o cliente na base através do sistema (colocando as informações de caixa e porta) e por fim confere se o plano adquirido está correto; Ativação via sistema(MOBA) Nokia (ONU): preencher planilha de ativação, acompanhar ativação com o técnico e inserir no sistema, posteriormente seguir os procedimentos de ativação.
  • Conferência de caixa: após ativação o técnico de campo liga para o suporte fazer conferência da caixa para identificar os clientes ativos de acordo com o endereço para verificar quais portas estão liberadas;

Through structured academy weeks, mentorship, and international exposure, you will develop skills needed to take on future roles within our supply chain

What we’re looking for:

Professional experience and passion: You have completed a master’s degree and have a genuine interest in end-to-end supply chain, with the analytical and problem-solving skills to thrive in a dynamic, international environment.

Language : Good proficiency of business English and local language

Global mobility and adaptability: Must be fully internationally mobile and ready for two global rotations. Candidates must hold permanent residency with a home country passport; visa sponsorship is not available.

Proactive learners : Enjoyment in mastering complex concepts and applying learnings in practical ways to make an impact.

Creative problem solvers: Ability to approach challenges creatively, thinking outside the box to find the best solutions.

Diversity & inclusion: Appreciation and respect for diverse perspectives and ability to share your own, and work inclusively.

Collaboration & entrepreneurial mindset: value working well with others, taking initiative, thriving in a team environment & bringing an innovative, problem-solving mindset.

Work eligibility: Candidates must hold permanent residency with a home country passport; visa sponsorship is not available.

Why Nutreco?

By choosing Nutreco, you’ll help us lead the change towards global sustainable food production, equipped with the best training and mentorship and a spirit of innovation. This program isn’t just about what you can bring to us, but how we can grow together, fostering a culture that sparks entrepreneurial mindset.

Young Professional Program description

We offer a special 18-month program, split into three six-month rotations on the job, normally in three different countries, in three different supply chain areas. The program is designed to help you fully develop yourself on a personal and professional level by understanding our end-to-end supply chain processes, including the interdependencies and interconnectedness between different areas. You will gain industry-specific knowledge and leverage the experience of experts in our different locations and Opcos.

Local hiring company - home location

You will spend the first six months at your home location gaining on-the-job experience with a real-life job, learning about key supply chain processes, systems, respective goods and services and dataflows. In parallel, you will also start to develop your personal network in a collaborative environment.

Plant and Opco locations

After the first six months working from your home location, you will spend several months in some of our international plants and locations. The focus here will be on gaining additional perspectives and learning about the day-to-day operational and strategic challenges. At this point, you may identify potential improvements to help us along in our continuous drive for optimisation.

YPP Academy Weeks

Each rotation starts with a Skills Development Academy week focused on job-specific learning and personal development. You will also meet your fellow global Young Professionals and benefit from a wide range of trainings and events.

During all the phases of your traineeship, you will work as part of the Supply Chain team on a challenging position, global project, operational business tasks and attend several training courses. This combination of on-the-job, projects, training and international experience will provide you with excellent skills and give you a solid head start on your career.

Step into your future

Recruitment process

  • Interview: Connect with your potential future manager to discuss your aspirations and potential fit.

  • Assessment: Review your values alignment, personality, and ability with Nutreco’s needs.

  • Offer: Join us in Feeding the Future!

For application details and more, visit the Nutreco career site . And be quick – the journey begins soon, and we’re eager to welcome our new cohort of visionaries.

To be eligible, candidates must have completed their Master’s program before the traineeship 1st of October 2025, be willing to undertake regional/international assignments; embody the qualities of collaboration and have an entrepreneurial spirit.

    • Assegurar o cumprimento de compromissos financeiros.
  • Indicadores Financeiros
    • Analisar KPIs financeiros, como margem de lucro, liquidez, endividamento e ROI.

  • Contas a Pagar e Receber

    • Atender as demandas das auditorias internas e externas.

  • Melhoria de Processos Financeiros
    • Revisar e otimizar processos financeiros para aumentar a eficiência.

Further your career at Ball, a world leader in manufacturing sustainable aluminium packaging. Achieve extraordinary things when you join our team, and make a difference in your professional development, the community, and around the globe!

Please, submit your resume in English .

Ball Corporation is looking for a well-rounded team player with broad technical leadership skills to add to our Global IT Security operations department. This position requires extensive knowledge in three or more of the following IT Security tools: Firewalls, Web Content Filtering, Web Application and Malware Protection, Intrusion Prevention System, SSL Decryption, Email Security, Strong Authentication, Remote Access, End Point Protection, Advanced Threat Management, Vulnerability Scanning & Remediation, Identity Management, Data Loss Prevention, Data Encryption, Security Incident Management, Public Key Infrastructure, Web Application Firewall, IT Security Forensics, Password Vaulting, Risk assessment, and security vulnerability assessment.

This position works within the Global IT Security team to solve complex IT Security problems by taking a broad perspective to identify innovative technical solutions. The successful candidate will provide mentorship and guidance to junior level cyber security analysts. The position also participates in managing our vendors to achieve the desired results including quality and on-time delivery. Working knowledge and relevant certifications in the above security tools is preferred.

Essential Responsibilities

  1. Security administration is a hands-on role that requires a high level of technical expertise including networking, operating systems, applications, cloud environments, and security.
  2. Responsible for a broad range of security tasks, including the day-to-day security administration of network security devices, as well as the management of technologies, such as firewall, intrusion detection, intrusion prevention, data loss prevention, antivirus, anti-spam, antispyware, and security information and event management (SIEM) tools.
  3. Monitor, analyze, and respond to security incidents and breaches swiftly and effectively, minimizing potential impact.
  4. Lead incident response efforts, coordinate investigations, and ensure all incidents are properly documented and reported.
  5. Serve as a subject matter expert on cybersecurity matters, both internally and externally.
  6. Conduct regular security audits and assessments to identify weaknesses in networks, systems, and applications, and recommend remediation actions.
  7. Create and maintain system and network diagrams as well as process documentation.
  8. Provide support to ensure planning and deployment is accomplished in coordination with system owners, engineers, and stakeholders and are consistent with appropriate infrastructure and security engineering requirements.
  9. Assess and prioritize cybersecurity risks and vulnerabilities across the organization's technology landscape.
  10. Follow up on remediation of vulnerabilities.
  11. Participate in design and implementation of new security controls.
  12. Stay current with cybersecurity threats and trends, providing ongoing intelligence and insights to inform security decision-making.

title: Operations Readiness & Start Up Manager
description:
NES Fircroft has a unique opportunity for a senior-level Operations Readiness & Start Up Manager, supporting the integration of a portfolio of high value projects into operations at a giant producing oilfield in Iraq.

The assignment is on a 12-month renewable contract, working on a 28/28 rotation.

Role synopsis

Our client is undertaking a large number of brownfield and greenfield projects in order to support and enhance production over the coming years.

This already complex field will increase in complexity requiring the incumbent to manage a challenging set of dynamic issues in the integration of the new projects into existing sites and the engagement of the site operations staff will be critical in ensuring the success of Rumaila for the coming years.

There is significant value at stake for this role to successfully manage a large project portfolio in one of the world’s largest oil fields, which comes with associated exposure to senior management.

The role ensures that the operational interfaces between operation and projects are effectively managed and with synergies maximised.

Accountable for driving continuous improvement across the projects start up & stay up.

The Operations Readiness & Start Up Manager functions under the Operations Organisation, reporting to the Senior Operations Manager.

The role includes significant people leadership and stakeholder management in an organisation of significant scale and complexity.

Key Accountabilities

  • Operations Readiness and Start-Up Manager is accountable to support projects and operations, acting as an interface in delivery of operations readiness for projects in service of safe, reliable and compliant start-up in the field.
  • Accountable for projects’ start-up in the field and pre-requisite activities to enable safe and efficient operations.
  • Understanding and experience in Operations Readiness & Assurance (OR&A) Delivery Requirements and project stage Gate readiness;
  • Proactive engagement with all operating departments to ensure the development will integrate into existing Brownfield Assets;
  • Promote a culture of safety and continuous improvement.
  • Accountable to interface with Project Management team at earlier stage of the project to ensure provision of Operations and Commissioning inputs and planning are considered to deliver the project in accordance with the Scope of requirements (SOR).
  • Establish an O&M strategy for startup and earlier Operations phases and ensure strategy is reviewed and accepted by all project stakeholders.
  • Manage the delivery of all required operational support contracts (such as Chemicals / vendor support agreements) to support the Asset in the Operate phase.
  • Develop an Operations readiness plan (ORP) including the key readiness elements and O&M deliverables for the required project phases including commissioning and start up and earlier operations, ensure they are communicated in timely manner to project stakeholders,
  • Interface with the Contract and Finance departments for Contractor Performance and financial controls
  • Liaise closely with the Project Manager to manage the interfaces, ensure alignment, and Identify areas of improvement, best practices, and lessons learned from other similar projects and implement.
  • Manage & maintain focus on operability & maintainability issues throughout all aspects of the project design & execution planning.
  • Develop and monitor key performance Indicators to measure the effectiveness of the different phases of the O&M Scope.
  • Support the project assurance processes (such as Model Reviews / Hazop, Hazid, etc).
  • Manage the acceptance & handover from Project to Operations using the approved certification process (such Guidance OF Certification) ensuring a structured plan is developed in advance and implemented at the different project phases.
  • Ensure that Contractor documents (Plans, Manuals, procedures, and Method Statements) are reviewed and commented by Operations and readiness team members.
  • Ensure start up and ramp up plans are developed taking inputs from project stakeholders to ensure flawless delivery.
  • Work in close collaboration with the Contractor Commissioning and Start-up Team to ensure commissioning and start-up activities are planned and scheduled in line with the project standards and procedures. This includes establishing Flawless Start-up strategy and implementation of the program as per project.
  • Manage the HSSE performance of contractors during execution phases to ensure HSSE targets are met or exceeded – make HSSE a priority. Run contractor performance review on regular basis.

Criteria & Qualifications

  • BSc or BEng (UK), or international equivalent in an engineering discipline, or equivalent experience
  • Professional accreditation, such as Professional Engineer or Chartered Engineer
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in operations or engineering role, with at least 5 years in a management or senior leadership position, with significant experience leading Readiness delivery on major projects, with emphasis on Middle East and preferably in Iraq.
  • Good understanding of project management, commissioning and start-up procedures and hand over projects to Operations.
  • Business focused, able to priorities to maximize opportunities with no compromise on HSE.
  • Deep understanding of all aspects of delivering Operational Excellence in a large asset.
  • Track record of visible Safety Leadership and demonstrable risk management skills, with clear knowledge and track record of Control of Work, HSE leadership and major incident control.
  • High awareness of safe working practices associated with FEED, design, construction, pre-commissioning, installation, hook- up and commissioning of oil & gas facilities.
  • Familiar with projects assurance processes such as hazard analysis methods such as HAZOP, HAZID / What-if, LOPA.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills demonstrated in the leadership of operating teams, influencing on contractors and change management.
  • Strong influencing skills and a track record of delivery, action-orientated and value-based decisions; ideally in a JV environment
  • Experience in overseas posting working with diverse cultures would be beneficial.

With over 90 years’ combined experience, NES Fircroft (NES) is proud to be the world’s leading engineering staffing provider spanning the Oil & Gas, Power & Renewables, Chemicals, Construction & Infrastructure, Life Sciences, Mining and Manufacturing sectors worldwide. With more than 80 offices in 45 countries, we are able to provide our clients with the engineering and technical expertise they need, wherever and whenever it is needed. Não fazemos distinção de cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade.
VEM SER GIGANTE, VEM TRABALHAR NA REDE DE FARMÁCIAS QUE É DO TAMANHO DO BRASIL
Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!
Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana , da superação de resultados , do foco no cliente , da sustentabilidade , da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.
Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore . Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde . Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos.
Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .
Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante! Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.

Venha fazer parte do Time Metrum!

Sobre a vaga:

Estamos expandindo o time comercial de novos negócios da XP Empresas. Vaga para a posição de Officer (Novos Negócios), que envolve prospecção, construção da carteira e relacionamento com as empresas. O dia a dia de trabalho oferece contato muito próximo com CFOs e CEOs das empresas e com nossos times de Renda Fixa, Produtos de Crédito, Seguros, Câmbio, Derivativos e Mercado de Capitais, dentre muitas outras áreas que garantem um ecossistema completo de serviços adaptados para nosso cliente.

A posição exige conhecimento sobre:

  • Gestão de Caixa;
  • Câmbio e Derivativos;
  • Análise de Crédito e Antecipação de Recebíveis;
  • Mercado de Capitais.

Para esta vaga, é essencial que você possua:

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;

  • Conhecimento sobre cenário econômico atual;

  • Certificação CPA-20;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente em São Paulo.

Você pode ter destaque se possuir:

  • Certificação CEA, CFP, CFG ou CGA.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade:

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura.
